messages:
maya_support: FYI customer (AcmeAI) just escalated — their A/B rollout dashboard shows variants flipped after last deploy, counts look inverted vs what their SDK returns. attaching logs and a screenshot link. cc @jessica_pm @mike_analytics

chris_customer: Repro steps we ran: 1) hit /assign with user_id=u123 -> SDK returns 'control' 2) check dashboard -> shows 'treatment' 3) total counts show ~1200 in treatment, ~300 in control (should be opposite). Screenshot: https://acme-screenshots.s3/ab-flip.png

jessica_pm: thanks — can you paste a raw assignment event and the rollout id? also which commit/deploy time did you start seeing this?

chris_customer: rollout_id=42. Example event payload from client: ```json
{"event":"ab_assign","user_id":"u123","rollout_id":42,"variant":"control","timestamp":"2026-03-17T09:22:31Z"}
``` We first noticed after your 2026-03-17 09:00 UTC deploy.

maya_support: customer also attached server ingestion log for same user: ```
2026-03-17T09:22:31Z INFO ingest: rollout=42 uid=u123 variant_key=ctrl source=sdk-v2
``` They say SDK shows variant 'control' but ingestion has 'ctrl' and dashboard maps 'ctrl' -> 'treatment' somehow.

mike_analytics: looking at counts now. quick query: ```sql
SELECT variant_key, count(*) FROM ab_assignments WHERE rollout_id=42 AND created_at >= '2026-03-16' GROUP BY 1;
-- results: ('ctrl', 1200), ('control', 300)
``` Customer claims SDK mapping expects 'control' ~1200. So either assignment_key normalization or mapping from variant_key->variant_name got swapped.

rahul_eng-frontend: we shipped a small key-shortening change in frontend SDK in that deploy: variant string 'control' was compacted to 'ctrl' to save payload size. Backend team was supposed to map 'ctrl' -> 'control' via rollout config. if the mapping missed a version bump, dashboard might have fallen back to label 'treatment' for unknown keys.

natalie_eng-backend: I see the ingestion logs. The pipeline stores raw variant_key and also resolves variant_name via the rollout config cached at ingestion time. The rollout config service returned an older config because we had a cache miss and hit the fallback which uses positional labels (index 0 -> treatment?). Investigating cache priming for rollout 42.

ops-bot: deploy event recorded: deploy-id=2026-03-17-09-00 (sha: a1b2c3). Affected service: api-ingest-v3.
\
deploy-bot: rollout: api-ingest-v3 -> new image deployed at 2026-03-17T09:00:12Z. postdeploy tasks: cache-refresh-job triggered at 09:00:40Z (status: succeeded).

maya_support: customer asked for immediate mitigation / ETA. Any hotfix we can run to correct dashboard counts (they're live and driving notifications)?
\
rahul_eng-frontend: short-term mitigation: add a compatibility header in SDK so ingestion maps 'ctrl' -> 'control' at parse time. But that needs a release and customer update.

natalie_eng-backend: faster fix: we can run a reconciliation job to remap historical rows where variant_key='ctrl' to variant='control' for rollout 42 and then re-aggregate dashboard metrics. Proposed one-off SQL: ```sql
BEGIN;
UPDATE ab_assignments SET variant_name='control' WHERE rollout_id=42 AND variant_key='ctrl' AND created_at >= '2026-03-17T09:00:00Z' AND created_at < '2026-03-17T10:00:00Z';
COMMIT;
``` This will fix counts in the dashboard. I can scope it to the time window we deployed. Will run after sign-off.

mike_analytics: confirm that re-aggregation picks up updated rows. I'll queue a reagg job for rollout 42 after the update. Also will add a sanity check comparing SDK-assigned counts (from assignment_events table) vs dashboard counts and alert if difference > 5%.

jessica_pm: approve the one-off update for now to stop customer churn. please add a postmortem action item to avoid this class of mismatch. @natalie_eng-backend @rahul_eng-frontend

natalie_eng-backend: running update in staging first. copying the exact safe query for prod: ```sql
-- safe check first
SELECT count(*) FROM ab_assignments WHERE rollout_id=42 AND variant_key='ctrl' AND created_at >= '2026-03-17T09:00:00Z' AND created_at < '2026-03-17T10:00:00Z';
-- if count looks like the affected bucket, then run UPDATE ...
``` ETA 15m for staging run, 45m for prod (includes reagg).

chris_customer: thanks. can you also confirm whether user-facing SDK behavior is stable? we don't want double assignments if you remap server-side.

rahul_eng-frontend: SDK still returns 'control' for users. The compacted key is an internal optimization — user-facing label unchanged. So remapping on server is safe.

maya_support: communicating to customer: will run a server-side fix in ~45m, will confirm when dashboards reflect corrected counts, and follow up with a postmortem and permanent fix. temporary workaround: customer can run their local assignment logs to verify user assignments until we confirm. :thumbsup:

mike_analytics: post-incident follow-ups: 1) add rollout config version to ingestion logs 2) add metric-compare alert 3) make mapping tolerant to short keys. I'll capture these in the incident board.

jessica_pm: adding to backlog and tagging owners. thanks everyone for quick triage.

chris_customer: appreciated. we'll stand by and let you know if anything else pops up.
